Regent's Park Chat Laps

London, United Kingdom · Regent's Park · Road

Regent's Park Chat Laps is a road group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls wednesdays and Fridays at 7:00 am local time from Inner Circle gates at the end of York Bridge, Regent's Park. Pace: chat laps — social pace.

For visitors

Non-members can come on trial rides; members get ride details in the club's Spond app. Park etiquette used by London clubs: groups of 12 at most, two abreast, never jump a red light.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: chat laps — social pace.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Regent's Park Chat Laps group ride

A pre-work hour of easy laps around the Outer Circle of Regent's Park, then coffee and buns. Cycle Club London calls itself 'a cycling club for all'. A gentle way to meet London riders on a weekday.
